channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Miles McBride | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Miles McBride from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Brown on Leon Rose, Miles McBride
item.description:
coach Mike Brown said on Wednesday.

“I addressed the group on that. I addressed individuals on that. There will probably be a time and place that I talk to [McBride] because he’s human, we’re all human, and we all want what’s best not just for ourselves but for our family as well as the organization, too. That’s a nice balancing act. But at the end of the day, he wants to be here, we want him to be here, and that’s something that I have faith in [president] Leon [Rose] and even Deuce’s representatives to figure that out.”

Mike Brown on Leon Rose, Miles McBride, Sep 30, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Josh Hart, Miles McBride
item.description:
“A lot of times, I turn, I open up my body to the opposite side and just see. … If the long pass is not there, (I) could get it quick to the guard, and the guard could make something happen: J.B., Deuce (McBride), Josh Hart.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Josh Hart, Miles McBride, Mar 17, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Landry Shamet, Miles McBride
item.description:
